changePassword.body: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.metaDescription: Cow dung and gomutra products from Uttar Pradesh gaushalas: agarbatti, havan cups, diyas, panchgavya soap, floor cleaner and organic manure.
catalog.heroTitle: Cow-derived goods, direct from Uttar Pradesh gaushalas
catalog.heroSubtitle: Dhoop and agarbatti, havan samagri, panchgavya soaps, gomutra ark and organic manure — made by gaushalas and small producers across the state.
catalog.notYetPricedBody: This listing was imported without a price. It becomes orderable once the seller sets one.

seller.productNameHint: Shown to buyers in search results.
seller.skuHint: Your own stock code. Must be unique.

staff.title: Staff users
staff.subtitle: Accounts that can sign in to the admin and seller tools.
staff.searchLabel: Search by name, email or mobile
staff.initialPasswordHint: They should change this after their first sign-in.
staff.confirmDeactivateBody: {{name}} will be signed out everywhere and will not be able to sign in again. Accounts are never deleted, so their history stays intact.
staff.confirmRolesBody: {{name}} will have exactly these roles: {{roles}}. This takes effect the next time their token refreshes.
staff.confirmRolesNone: {{name}} will be left with no roles, which removes all administrative access.
staff.auditNote: This change is recorded in the audit log against your account.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: This page needs a permission your account does not have.

footer.tagline: A state marketplace for gaushala and rural producers of Uttar Pradesh.
footer.sellBody: Gaushalas and registered producers can list their products and reach buyers across India.
footer.helpBody: Questions about an order or a listing? Reach the support desk from your account page.
footer.copyright: © 2026 UP Bazaar. A Government of Uttar Pradesh initiative.

checkout.fixCart: Something in your basket has changed.

orders.title: My orders
orders.none: You haven't placed any orders yet.
orders.placedTitle: Thank you, your order is placed.
orders.placedBody: Your order number is {{number}}. We will let you know as it ships.
orders.cancelQuestion: Cancel the whole order? This cannot be undone.

partStatus.Returning: Could not be delivered - going back

return.until: You can ask to return it until {{date}}.
return.commentRequired: Tell the seller what is wrong.
return.upiHint: You paid in cash, so the refund is sent to this UPI id, such as name@okicici.
return.wholeParcel: The whole parcel goes back. You are refunded {{amount}} once it reaches the seller.
return.sent: Return requested. The seller will reply soon.
return.requested: You asked to return this on {{date}}. Waiting for the seller to reply.
return.approved: Return accepted. A courier will collect the parcel from your delivery address.
return.refundUpi: Back with the seller. Your refund of {{amount}} will be sent to {{upi}}.
return.refundOnline: Back with the seller. Your refund of {{amount}} will go back to your original payment.
return.rejected: The seller did not accept this return: {{note}}

payments.dueBy: Pay by {{time}} or the order will be cancelled.
payments.testModeNote: No real payment gateway is set up here. Simulate a successful payment to try the flow.
payments.paid: Payment received. Your order is confirmed.
payments.processing: Payment received. Your order will be confirmed in a moment.
payments.refundDue: Payment received, but this order could no longer take it. The money will be refunded to you.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Online payments and the refunds owed out of them.
payments.markRefundedBody: Refund {{amount}} for order {{number}} in the Razorpay dashboard against payment {{payment}}, then enter the refund id Razorpay shows.
payments.markRefundedUpiBody: Send {{amount}} for order {{number}} to the UPI id {{upi}}, then enter the transaction reference (UTR) your bank shows.

shipping.missingPackages: No package recorded for {{skus}}. Weigh and measure the box.
shipping.suggested: Worked out from the products. Correct it if the box you used differs.
shipping.pickupSubtitle: Names must match pickup locations registered in Shiprocket. Sellers without their own ship from the platform warehouse.
shipping.noPickups: No pickup locations yet. Add the platform warehouse first.
shipping.sellerIdOptional: Seller id (blank for the platform warehouse)

sellerPortal.registerIntro: Create an account first. Then tell us about your shop, and we will review it.
sellerPortal.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
sellerPortal.applyIntro: Tell us about your shop. We review every application before a shop can sell.
sellerPortal.pendingNote: We will get back to you soon. You cannot edit it while it is in review.
sellerPortal.kycNote: Your legal and bank details cannot be changed after approval without contacting support.
sellerPortal.liveLocked: This listing is live. To change its wording or category, contact a moderator. Price, stock and package can be changed below.
sellerPortal.packageNote: One unit, packed. Couriers price on this, so weigh the packed box.
sellerPortal.pickupOwn: Couriers collect from your pickup location "{{name}}".
sellerPortal.pickupWarehouse: You ship from the platform warehouse, "{{name}}".
sellerPortal.pickupHelp: To collect from your own address, register it as a pickup location in Shiprocket and enter its name here exactly.

listingReview.title: Listings to review
listingReview.subtitle: Sellers' new listings. Publish them, or send them back saying what to fix.

settlements.payoutsSubtitle: What each seller is owed, gathered every Monday. Send the transfer, then record its UTR.
settlements.markPaidBody: Send {{amount}} to {{holder}}, account {{account}}, IFSC {{ifsc}}. Then enter the transaction reference (UTR) your bank gives.
settlements.ratesSubtitle: These apply to parcels delivered from now on. Earnings already made keep their rates.
settlements.taxNote: Tax rates start at 0. Set them as your accountant advises.
settlements.noOverrides: Every seller pays the default commission.
settlements.earningsNote: You are paid for a parcel once the buyer's return window has closed. Payouts are made every Monday to your bank account.

catalogAdmin.title: Products
catalogAdmin.subtitle: Every listing, from every seller, in any state.
catalogAdmin.readOnly: You can see this listing but not change it.
catalogAdmin.inReview: The seller is waiting for this listing to be reviewed.
catalogAdmin.archivedNote: This listing is archived. Only its package can still change, for orders already placed.
catalogAdmin.archiveBody: "{{name}}" leaves the shop for good. Orders already placed keep it. There is no undo: to sell it again, create a new listing.

categoriesAdmin.subtitle: Shelves in the shop. Top-level categories make up the storefront's category rail.
categoriesAdmin.name: Name
categoriesAdmin.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed. Only a category with no products, archived ones included, and no sub-categories can be deleted.

returns.requestTitle: The buyer wants to return this parcel
returns.rejectNote: Why are you refusing? The buyer sees this.
returns.approvedToast: Return accepted. A courier pickup is being booked.
returns.awaitingPickup: Return accepted. The parcel is on its way back.
returns.pickupFailed: The return pickup is not booked yet: {{error}}
returns.inspectBody: Check it. If it can be sold again, its stock goes back on sale.
returns.good: Good - put it back on sale

inspectedAs.Good: Returned and put back on sale.

reviews.unavailable: Reviews could not be loaded just now.
